blocks.text: Hasna Cabral, former “Pinoy Big Brother: Otso” housemate, Filipina actress and host, died on Wednesday, Nov. 25, following a stroke that affected brain activity. Cabral was 37. She first gained national recognition in 2019 as the “Ukay Nanay ng Cavite” during her stint on the popular reality show. Cabral used to be known then as Hasna Usman. That defining persona became her most iconic role in the public eye, as viewers admired her grit as a single mother raising two children on the autism spectrum, Basha and Baste.
